groups.defect: Removing the BuildIndex-wide lock lets the errgroup goroutines in searchSupport.init build in parallel, so they race on the shared captured `err` and on the `totalBatchesIndexed` counter.
groups.rationale: Both report the same data race on the shared err and counter in init's errgroup, and both propose a goroutine-local err plus an atomic counter.

groups.defect: Locking only the final cache write lets concurrent BuildIndex calls for the same key both run, so the last one to finish overwrites the cached index, writes are lost or leaked, and bleve.New conflicts on the same directory.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same check-then-build race in getOrCreateIndex/BuildIndex caused by the narrowed lock, and both suggest the same fix: per-key deduplication or re-checking the cache under the lock.
